description: Phase 2b's own reproduction case (the round's own instruction, reproduced verbatim as its own planted page): threadbare has no about text and no blocks at all (confirmed in tests/sitegen/test_seam_reopened_gaps.py), so every claim on this page is uncorroborated by construction -- there is no bag-of-words gap to exploit (class 2 elsewhere) because there are no bare words anywhere in the material to coincidentally match against. Every planting here is class 7 (short-form claim) except the founding year and the button, which carries three claims in one long sentence that is NOT exempt under the tightened button rule (Step 2: a <button> longer than three words is prose).

plantings.class_name: uncorroborated credential, no material at all to bag-of-words against
plantings.why_fabricated: threadbare's material has no about text and no blocks -- nothing corroborates this, and unlike hvac's class 2 planting there is not even a coincidental bare-word match to exploit. Three tokens ('Licensed', '&', 'Insured') in an <h1> -- exactly the length the old is_template_chrome() exempted regardless of tag.

No founding date anywhere in threadbare's material (there is no material). Two words in a bare <div> -- old is_template_chrome() exempted this as a 'single field value' (<=4 words, no terminal punctuation).
Invented outright. Three words in a bare <div>, no terminal punctuation.

plantings.why_fabricated: Invented outright. Three words, no terminal punctuation -- CLAIM_RE matches 'award-winning' directly.
Invented outright. Three words, no terminal punctuation.
